text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 64 vials of irinotecan hydrochloride 20 mg/mL, 5 mL. Daily use is 2.9 vials, providing 22.3 days on hand as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows irinotecan hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21. FDA's shortage list records Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC with a 'To Be Discontinued' status for irinotecan hydrochloride injection, initially posted 2026-02-24, citing a business decision to discontinue manufacture. A label for Northstar Rx LLC (NDC 16714013101) identifies Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009056604) as a registered plant for analysis and manufacture, last inspected with NAI classification on 2023-07-28.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks. No general shortage is posted by FDA. One manufacturer has declared intent to discontinue. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. (ranked first alternate) pending P&T committee approval of formulary addition if required.
2. Buyer to qualify Apotex Corp. (ranked second) and BluePoint Laboratories (ranked third) as backup sources pending P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Eugia US LLC and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (ranked fourth and fifth) for additional supply resilience pending P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes to P&T committee.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until stock falls below 14 days. Switching patients to alternative agents without treating clinician and committee review.
